source.snippet: SFMC operator warming a new dedicated IP for ~900,000 members asks whether starting at 5,000 recipients 3x/week is safe vs. Salesforce's recommended 500/day ramp. Business context: large subscriber list, dedicated IP, marketing cloud license.

problem_statement: Email marketers running Salesforce Marketing Cloud dedicated IP warming lack a simple, data-driven ramp calculator that accounts for list size, send frequency, and deliverability signals — forcing reliance on contradictory blog posts and guesswork.
target_segment: Email marketing managers and deliverability engineers at companies with 100k+ subscriber lists using Salesforce Marketing Cloud or other ESPs with dedicated IPs
notes: Buyer signal: operator manages 900k-member list on a paid SFMC dedicated IP license — significant spend context. Pain is decision uncertainty around IP warming schedules. Opportunity: a SaaS IP warming planner/monitor that reads deliverability metrics and recommends send volume adjustments.
